patent_title: Low content nitrile cross-linked powdery acrylonitrile butadiene preparation method
monomer_ratio: 28 parts of acrylonitrile to 72 parts of butadiene
emulsifier: fatty acid potassium-potassium oleate composite emulsifier
coagulation: saturated NaCl solution with pH 9 as coagulant
polymer_properties: solid content: 35.6 percent; pH value: 10.7; structural gel content: 78 percent; mooney viscosity: 125; bound acrylonitrile: 26.2 percent
experimental_notes: vacuumizing a polymerization kettle, sequentially adding ingredients, heating to 29 +/-1 ℃, then to 47 +/-1 ℃, adding sodium ferulate to terminate the reaction
